 TRAI Launches Network Anubhav Platform to Compare Internet Speeds and Manage Spam
 TRAI has launched the Network Anubhav Platform to help users compare internet speeds by location, check network performance and access DND services to report unwanted calls and messages.
 By Vajiram Prelims Team - Nov 5, 2026, 13:07 IST

 Network Anubhav Platform Latest News 
 Recently, the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) launched the Network Anubhav Platform. 
 About Network Anubhav Platform 
 It is a geospatial dashboard that allows consumers to view location-specific network test results and access Do Not Disturb (DND) services through a web interface. 
 It was launched by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI). 
 ‹ 
 › 
 Features of Network Anubhav Platform 
 It combines consumer test data with its independent drive test results to help consumers compare networks by location and telecom operators identify areas for network improvement. 
 User test data comprises the test results from MySpeed and MyCall apps of TRAI. 
 The platform delivers insights on various network parameters to consumers, service providers and TRAI. 
 The platform displays speed indicators based on tests conducted by users in a given area. These include median speeds and values indicating the speeds recorded at or above a specified level in 80 per cent of mobile broadband tests and 90 per cent of fixed broadband tests. 
 The portal also provides web access to DND facilities, allowing consumers to register preferences for commercial communications , submit complaints about unsolicited communications and track their status. 
 Source: LM
